ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious XOR Encoded PowerShell Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects presence of a potentially xor encoded powershell command

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll") OR process_description = "Windows\ PowerShell" OR process_product = "PowerShell\ Core\ 6") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*bxor.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ForEach.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*for\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*for\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-join\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-join\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-join\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-join\\`.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\:Join.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\[char\\].*")))
